opening: My right eye has been red.
Bright light bothers my right eye.
The vision in my right eye is slightly blurry.
The light sensitivity, the pain and the blurriness started 3 days ago.

opening.text: My right eye has been red for 5 days. The light sensitivity, the pain and the blurriness started 3 days ago. Bright light bothers my right eye, it hurts, and the vision in it is slightly blurry.
